description: Seoul Open Data Plaza (서울 열린데이터광장) is a data portal run by Seoul Metropolitan Government. The plaza lists thousands of data sets and open APIs of the city, including subway and bus ridership, real-time arrival, traffic, water supply, sewer, air and flood data, with an API key for the interfaces. Coverage: Seoul. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, xlsx, api; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("서울 열린데이터광장") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support urban transport, water and disaster studies of Seoul. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
